_about: Gift & adoption transfer classes (List 23 #217) over #168's record semantics and #68's protocol. The operation is unchanged for every class: exactly one seat (current keeper) rewrites, one history entry appends, all #168 invariants ride along, #68's locks evaluate first. Classes differ only in occasion. No class carries a price/consideration field — by construction (#56 M1 applied to persons).

adoption.from: a shelter custodial record (#220) — custody, never keeping
adoption.history: the full prior chain stays legible, including the surrender/stray-intake entry; adoption never launders a past
adoption.met_via: adoption (proposed addition to #68's stamp vocabulary — lands in #68/#168's home with citation)
adoption.validity: an adoption cannot stamp over an open seeking state (reunion conflict is #220's procedure; the format refuses the stamp)

gift.consideration: none expressible — no price, fee, or reciprocal-value slot exists in the shape
gift.shape: #68's degenerate case: one-way escrow, request: null

programme_gift.note: founded in #222; cited here so all classes share one stamp vocabulary

invariants: current keeper is the only seat rewritten; location set by the receiver on commit (#106 kinds, no fourth kind)
previous_keepers[] is append-only and never anonymised — the giver stays legible forever
deviations[], honours (#104), care history (#28 careLog), seed, variance: untouched by every class
story_locked individuals can never be escrowed, hence never gifted or adopted out (#68 locks)
open_register: every #104 honour occasion a gift/adoption may stamp (proposals into #104's home)
whether NPC Rangers gift in-world (instances: none)
